== Course of events ==

Following her encounter with the Mouse and her discovery of a large blue Caterpillar smoking a hookah, Alice finds herself entering the White Rabbit's house. Once within its walls, her purpose becomes clear: to locate the requested items, which she successfully finds.

Yet the discovery of these items pales beside another: an unlabeled bottle standing near the looking glass. It bears no label, no mark of its contents or purpose—merely the mystery of what lies within. It is a small thing, and yet it captures her attention in this strange dwelling.

This unmarked bottle proves fateful beyond measure. When Alice later drinks from it, her body undergoes an extraordinary transformation, swelling to such an enormous size that she becomes trapped within the small room, unable to escape as she continues to grow. The bottle discovered in this moment of search, within the White Rabbit's house, has become the agent of her next trial in Wonderland.
